application.name: OptiStash
application.description: Warehouse management: master data, inbound and QC, inventory, outbound, quality (CAPA, ISO 9001) and IoT integration.

capabilities.name: Inventory analysis
capabilities.description: FSN, ABC, VED, HML, SDE, XYZ and EOQ analysis with combined matrices.

capabilities.name: Quality management (ISO 9001)
capabilities.description: Non-conformance, CAPA, calibration control, audit trail and controlled documents.

capabilities.name: IoT gateway
capabilities.description: Telemetry ingestion, environmental monitoring and sensor binding.

capabilities.name: Supplier portal
capabilities.description: External supplier self-service for purchase orders and ASNs.

permissions.name: Access: access.role.manage
permissions.description: Create, change and delete custom roles

permissions.name: Access: access.role.view
permissions.description: View roles and permissions

permissions.name: Access: access.user.manage
permissions.description: Assign roles to members

permissions.name: Inbound: asn.approve
permissions.description: Confirm and schedule ASNs and approve receiving exceptions

permissions.name: Inbound: asn.manage
permissions.description: Create, change and upload ASNs (also for a supplier)

permissions.name: Quality: audit.view
permissions.description: Search the immutable audit trail

permissions.name: Quality: calibration.manage
permissions.description: Manage measuring equipment and its calibration

permissions.name: Quality: capa.manage
permissions.description: Register non-conformances and manage CAPA with root-cause analysis

permissions.name: Inbound: dock.manage
permissions.description: Book docks and record gate-in and gate-out of trucks

permissions.name: Inbound: inbound.view
permissions.description: View ASNs, dock bookings, receipts and putaway tasks

permissions.name: Integration: integration.manage
permissions.description: Configure transport integration, standalone mode and force a sync

permissions.name: Integration: integration.view
permissions.description: View integration status (OptiNexus, TMS, IoT)

permissions.name: Inventory: inventory.analysis.configure
permissions.description: Configure and run inventory analysis and combined matrices

permissions.name: Inventory: inventory.analysis.view
permissions.description: View inventory analysis results (FSN, ABC, VED, HML, SDE, XYZ, EOQ)

permissions.name: Inventory: inventory.lock
permissions.description: Lock and unlock stock (audit hold, quality quarantine)

permissions.name: Inventory: inventory.view
permissions.description: View stock, locations content and the stock map

permissions.name: Integration: iot.manage
permissions.description: Manage IoT gateways, devices and telemetry alerts

permissions.name: Master data: location.block
permissions.description: Block and unblock storage locations (a location with stock needs a reason)

permissions.name: Master data: master.manage
permissions.description: Create and change warehouses, storage topology, products, packaging and partners

permissions.name: Master data: master.view
permissions.description: View warehouses, storage topology, products, packaging and partners

permissions.name: Outbound: outbound.execute
permissions.description: Pick, pack and dispatch

permissions.name: Outbound: outbound.manage
permissions.description: Create outbound orders, run allocation and plan waves

permissions.name: Outbound: outbound.view
permissions.description: View outbound orders, waves, pick tasks and dispatches

permissions.name: Master data: partner.provision
permissions.description: Provision supplier portal accounts

permissions.name: Inbound: putaway.execute
permissions.description: Confirm putaway tasks and override a recommended location

permissions.name: Inbound: qc.inspect
permissions.description: Inspect received goods and decide conforming, quarantine or reject

permissions.name: Quality: quality.view
permissions.description: View non-conformances, CAPA, calibration and controlled documents

permissions.name: Inbound: receiving.execute
permissions.description: Receive goods against an ASN (scan, lot, expiry, labels)

permissions.name: Quality: sop.manage
permissions.description: Manage controlled SOP documents and their versions

permissions.name: Inventory: stocktake.approve
permissions.description: Approve count discrepancies and stock adjustments (never your own)

permissions.name: Inventory: stocktake.manage
permissions.description: Plan and execute cycle counts and stock takes

permissions.name: Supplier portal: supplier.portal
permissions.description: Use the supplier portal (requires a supplier-bound membership)

permissions.name: Outbound: wave.approve
permissions.description: Approve waves and partial shipments

permissions.name: Warehouse: wms.access
permissions.description: Use the warehouse application (baseline of every internal user)
